title: Publish with no Stripe, no location, no photo; Book hidden
steps: 1) Sign up a new artist and verify email; 2) complete profile, choose "Later" on photo, add one service; 3) skip location and payments; 4) publish; 5) open /a/:handle anonymously; 6) call availability-search and booking-create for this artist.
expected_result: Public page returns 200 with name/specialties; no Book or Book-this-look buttons; availability-search returns no bookable groups; booking-create returns 422 NOT_BOOKABLE; Home shows add-photo nudge.

title: Onboarding resumes after reload and on another device
steps: 1) Enter profile values and reach the services step; 2) reload; 3) sign in from a fresh browser context.
expected_result: Both sessions land on the same step with all entered values restored from onboarding_progress (server), not local storage.

title: Handle validation and inline collision message
steps: 1) Type an existing handle in a different case; 2) type a reserved word (e.g. "admin"); 3) type "ab" and "Ari Monroe!".
expected_result: Inline, screen-reader-announced errors for taken, reserved and invalid (^[a-z0-9-]{3,30}$); Continue disabled; available handle shows confirmation.

title: Concurrent handle claims: exactly one wins
steps: 1) In two transactions claim "ari-m" and "ARI-M" simultaneously; 2) commit both.
expected_result: Exactly one commit succeeds; the other fails with unique violation mapped to 409 HANDLE_TAKEN; no partial profile rows.

title: Profile photo upload rejects bad files
steps: 1) Request photo-upload-url and upload a PDF renamed .jpg; 2) upload a 10.1 MB JPEG; 3) upload a valid HEIC.
expected_result: PDF and >10 MB rejected (422, no stored object); HEIC accepted and converted; MIME checked by content sniffing, not extension.

title: Photo processing strips EXIF GPS and creates variants
steps: 1) Upload a JPEG containing EXIF GPS; 2) run photo-process; 3) read back each variant.
expected_result: Variants 96/256/512 px exist; none (nor the original stored copy) contains GPS or other EXIF location tags; photo_variants recorded.

title: "Later" on the photo step never blocks
steps: 1) Tap Later on 02b; 2) continue to publish.
expected_result: Flow continues; publish checklist shows photo as optional; nudge appears on Home and Settings until a photo exists.

title: Draft profile is private and not in sitemap
steps: 1) Create a draft (unpublished) artist; 2) GET /a/:handle anonymously and via public-artist; 3) fetch sitemap.xml; 4) check index toggle defaults.
expected_result: 404 for page and function; handle absent from sitemap; drafts carry noindex; published page index toggle defaults ON.

title: Onboarding accessibility and narrow widths
steps: 1) Run every onboarding screen at 320/360/390 px in EN and ES; 2) keyboard-only completion; 3) axe scan; 4) VoiceOver/TalkBack spot check.
expected_result: No horizontal scroll or clipped text; logical focus order; zero axe serious/critical issues; all controls labelled; html lang matches locale.

title: Crawler without JS receives full showcase HTML
steps: 1) Fetch /a/:handle with JS disabled and a crawler user agent; 2) parse HTML head and body.
expected_result: Name, specialties, services, locations present in HTML; canonical = base URL (tab param excluded); OpenGraph image/title; hreflang per ADR-0003.

title: Book this look preselects the mapped service
steps: 1) Tap Book this look on a mapped look; 2) go back; 3) tap an unmapped look.
expected_result: Mapped look opens picker 25 with that service preselected; unmapped look opens service choice instead.

title: Services deposit text equals server deposit per location
steps: 1) For every seeded service × location, read Services tab text and the server deposit(); 2) include fixed, percent, none and a salon-collected location.
expected_result: Text exactly matches server value and location ("$40 deposit at Studio 9"); salon-collected shows "no deposit"; "from" shown when overrides differ.

title: Unpublished portfolio media not fetchable by URL guessing
steps: 1) Upload a portfolio item and leave it unpublished; 2) request its storage path, public URL pattern and listing endpoint anonymously.
expected_result: All requests 403/404; listing excludes it; no signed URL issued to anonymous callers.

title: Looks/Services tab keeps scroll and is announced
steps: 1) Scroll Looks; 2) switch to Services and scroll; 3) switch back.
expected_result: Each tab restores its own scroll position; the switch is announced (selected state on tab, live region).

title: Deposit rounding table and salon-collected $0
steps: 1) Run deposit() over the table: 15000@2500bps→3750; 9999@3333bps→3333; 1@5000bps→1; 15000@10000bps→15000; fixed 20000 on price 15000→15000 (capped); fixed 4000→4000; none→0; any type with payment_collector=salon→0.
expected_result: Every row matches; formula floor((price×bps+5000)/10000); results are integer minor units; DB CHECK rejects percent >10000.

title: Salon-collected location shows $0 deposit everywhere
steps: 1) Enable a deposit on a service offered at a salon-collected location; 2) inspect showcase Services, picker summary, checkout, appointment detail, claim page and a concierge answer about the deposit.
expected_result: Every surface shows no deposit for that location; checkout collects no payment; concierge answer says payment is at the salon.

title: Two locations with different hours give different slots
steps: 1) Location A 9–5 and Location B 1–7 on the same Thursday; 2) run availability for the same service.
expected_result: Slots fall only within each location's hours in its own timezone; groups differ accordingly.

title: DST spring-forward / fall-back slot generation and reschedule
steps: 1) Generate slots for America/New_York on 2027-03-14 and 2027-11-07; 2) reschedule an appointment from the day before each transition to the day after.
expected_result: No nonexistent local times; repeated hour handled once; UTC instants correct; rescheduled appointment keeps local wall-clock time and identity.

title: Inactive service or location cannot be booked via API
steps: 1) Deactivate a service; 2) call booking-create directly with it; 3) repeat with an inactive location.
expected_result: 422 SERVICE_INACTIVE / LOCATION_INACTIVE; no appointment or hold created.

title: Request-mode slots labelled "Ari confirms" everywhere
steps: 1) Book a request-location slot; 2) inspect picker 25, checkout 26, status 28, client card, claim page 31d, confirmation email/SMS (sandbox), concierge reply.
expected_result: Every client surface carries the "Ari confirms" / request wording; none says "confirmed" or "booked" for the request.

title: Request booking is never shown or sent as confirmed
steps: 1) Guest requests a salon slot; 2) inspect status page, emails, SMS, wallet card text; 3) artist suggests a different available time; 4) client accepts the suggestion; 5) re-inspect.
expected_result: Before artist acceptance or client acceptance of a suggested time: status pending_artist and no "confirmed" copy; after acceptance of the original or suggested time: status confirmed and the outbox event carries the client locale.

title: Idempotent booking-create
steps: 1) Send booking-create three times with the same Idempotency-Key, sequentially and then concurrently.
expected_result: One appointment, one hold, one payment intent; identical response bodies; no duplicate outbox events.

title: Concurrent overlapping instant bookings
steps: 1) Fire 20 concurrent booking-create calls for overlapping intervals (including buffer overlap) at one instant location.
expected_result: At most one confirmed/hold; others 409 SLOT_TAKEN; per-location row locking prevents overlapping commits without a PostgreSQL extension; no orphaned holds.

title: Date-first picker: enabled days, location groups, mode tags
steps: 1) Seed a day with suite (instant) and salon (request) hours plus a fully booked day; 2) open picker 25.
expected_result: Days with 0 slots disabled/"Full"; open counts correct; chosen day shows two groups, "Confirmed instantly" and "Ari confirms" with icon + text.

title: Deposit-required booking not confirmed before payment
steps: 1) Book a deposit service at an artist-collected location; 2) abandon Stripe checkout; 3) let hold expire; 4) repeat and complete payment.
expected_result: Abandoned: pending_payment with 10-min hold, then expired and slot released; paid: confirmed only after webhook success.

title: Request expiry releases hold and queues a locale-bearing notice
fixtures: Rooted Beauty seed fixture; synthetic rows inside rollback transaction
steps: 1) Insert a due pending_artist request for an es-US client and a due pending_payment booking with an active hold; 2) call mova_expire_booking_requests(now()); 3) verify both appointments expire, the hold expires, each event/outbox row is unique and locale-bearing; 4) call expiry again and verify it changes zero rows.
expected_result: Both appointments expire; active hold becomes expired; one appointment event and outbox event per booking carry the original locale; a second call returns 0. P11 delivery is a separate downstream concern; no provider send occurs in this DB case.

title: Booking expiry cron route is secret-protected and handles RPC outcomes
fixtures: synthetic env and mocked Supabase client
steps: 1) Call route without the secret; 2) omit server config; 3) mock successful and failed expiry RPC responses.
expected_result: Unauthenticated and unconfigured requests fail closed; success returns expired count; failures return generic 503 without leaking database details.

title: Cancel / no-show emits exactly one slot.opened
fixtures: Rooted Beauty seed fixture; synthetic appointment rows and temporary external ownership change in rollback transaction
steps: 1) Create confirmed appointments at the Mova studio and request-mode salon; 2) temporarily set salon calendar ownership to external; 3) cancel the first appointment and replay the same idempotency key; 4) mark the second Mova appointment no-show; 5) cancel the external-calendar appointment.
expected_result: Cancellation and no-show at Mova-controlled locations each emit exactly one slot.opened event; replay creates no duplicate; external-calendar cancellation emits none. Test transaction rolls back all rows and location changes.

title: Running late texts the next client
steps: 1) Open a confirmed appointment; 2) review the identified same-day next client; 3) select a delay and queue the update.
expected_result: The sheet identifies the next client's name, service, local time and location. The route submits the appointment and selected delay; P06 queues a locale-bearing same-day transactional event, and P11 delivers/logs the message. The salon is not notified.

title: Cross-tenant client reads denied
steps: 1) With artist A's JWT query artist B's clients via PostgREST, RPC and every function taking a client ID.
expected_result: All denied or empty; no row counts or existence leaked in errors.

title: Opt-out stops all non-transactional sends immediately
steps: 1) Client replies STOP (and separately is toggled to opted out by artist); 2) trigger autopilot, slot offer, win-back and review request for them; 3) trigger a booking confirmation.
expected_result: All non-transactional sends skipped with reason opted_out; transactional appointment_updates still sent if consented; effective without delay.

title: Import preview performs no writes
steps: 1) Count rows in clients, client_consents, client_import_batches; 2) run client-import-preview with 50 rows; 3) recount.
expected_result: Counts unchanged (preview may write only an ephemeral preview record if ADR says so, never clients/consents).

title: Ambiguous duplicates require explicit resolution
steps: 1) Import a CSV containing two fuzzy matches; 2) try Import; 3) resolve with Merge and Keep both.
expected_result: Import disabled until every ambiguous row is resolved; no silent merge; result counts match choices.

title: Imported contacts default to no marketing consent
steps: 1) Commit an import; 2) read client_consents for imported clients.
expected_result: No rebooking_reminders or offers consent exists (or status OFF); evidence notes import source.

title: Re-importing the same CSV is idempotent
steps: 1) Commit an import; 2) commit the same file again.
expected_result: Second run creates no new clients; exact duplicates reported.

title: Client deletion and export workflow
steps: 1) Artist exports one client; 2) artist deletes a client; 3) check audit_events and retention notice.
expected_result: Export contains the client's data (incl. notes for the artist); deletion removes/anonymises per retention table with ledger exceptions; both audited.

title: Client records isolated from the public showcase
steps: 1) Seed client names; 2) crawl every public route and public function response.
expected_result: No client name, contact or tag appears in any public payload.

title: Consent evidence and provenance recorded
steps: 1) Grant consent at checkout, sign-in and profile; 2) import a client.
expected_result: Each consent row has channel, purpose, locale, evidence (form, IP hash, timestamp, copy version); imported clients carry source.

title: Client filter chips and linked-profile status
steps: 1) Apply All, Due to rebook, New, Opted out; 2) open a linked client.
expected_result: Filters return correct sets; linked status shows "linked"/"not linked" only, no profile data beyond what the client shared.

title: Money screen reconciles to ledger sums
steps: 1) Load the fixture month with processed, recorded, salon, fees and refunds; 2) compare each Money component with SQL sums over financial_ledger.
expected_result: Every component equals the SQL ground truth to the cent; estimate = processed − platform fee − processor fee − refunds + recorded_artist.

title: No platform fee or Stripe call on recorded or salon money
steps: 1) Record cash, zelle_recorded, other and salon_collected payments; 2) inspect ledger and the Stripe mock call log.
expected_result: Collector classified correctly (artist/salon); platform_fee 0; zero Stripe API calls; salon money excluded from estimated money to you.

title: "Estimated money to you" label in both locales
steps: 1) Render Money in EN and ES.
expected_result: Label marked as an estimate in both; no payroll or tax claims.

title: Webhook replay and out-of-order events
steps: 1) Deliver payment_intent.succeeded twice (same event id); 2) deliver succeeded before created; 3) deliver an invalid signature.
expected_result: One payment and one ledger posting; final state correct; invalid signature rejected 400 and not stored as processed.

title: Deposit then remaining balance
steps: 1) Book with $40 deposit on $150; 2) complete; 3) pay $110 via pay link.
expected_result: Balance 0; ledger totals = $150 gross; no duplicate charge; Money and appointment show the same figures.

title: Disconnected Stripe blocks checkout but not the showcase
steps: 1) Disconnect Stripe; 2) try to book a deposit service; 3) view showcase.
expected_result: Showcase works; deposit services cannot be booked online (clear message); no charge attempted.

title: Refunds are reversing ledger entries after processor confirmation
steps: 1) Request a refund; 2) deliver refund webhook pending then succeeded.
expected_result: State follows processor confirmation; ledger gets a negative refund entry; original entries untouched (immutable).

title: Failed payment and dispute visible
steps: 1) Simulate payment_failed and a dispute in sandbox.
expected_result: Appointment/Money show failed and disputed states read-only; no false "paid".

title: Fee audit records plan version and inputs
steps: 1) Compute platformFee for each proposed plan bps on a fixture payment.
expected_result: round_half_up(amount×bps/10000); plan version snapshotted on the payment; only collector=mova_processed incurs a fee.

title: Client-supplied price/fee tampering rejected
steps: 1) Call booking-create / paylink-create with altered price, deposit or fee fields.
expected_result: Server recomputes from catalog; tampered fields ignored or 422; charged amount equals server amount.

title: Google event create/update/cancel uses one provider event
steps: 1) Book, reschedule and cancel with Google connected (mock adapter + recorded fixtures).
expected_result: One external_calendar_events mapping; same provider event updated then cancelled; no duplicates on retry.

title: Apple feed token rotation
steps: 1) Fetch the .ics feed; 2) rotate; 3) fetch old and new URLs.
expected_result: Old URL 401/404; new URL valid; token ≥256-bit, stored hashed, never logged; no client PII by default.

title: Calendar privacy default is service name only
steps: 1) Sync a booking with default privacy to Google and ICS.
expected_result: Event title/description contain the service only; no client name, phone or email.

title: ICS correctness: UID, SEQUENCE, DTSTAMP, timezone
steps: 1) Generate feed before and after a reschedule across DST.
expected_result: UID stable; SEQUENCE increments; valid DTSTAMP and VTIMEZONE; cancellations represented; RFC 5545 validator passes.

title: Disconnected provider shows non-blocking state
steps: 1) Revoke Google token; 2) open Calendar sync and Appointment detail.
expected_result: Degraded/disconnected status with reconnect; booking unaffected.

title: External events never block availability (V1)
steps: 1) Add events to the connected Google calendar overlapping open hours.
expected_result: Availability unchanged (no inbound blocking in V1); Calendar banner explains one-way sync.

title: Calendar provider outage during sync
steps: 1) Make the Google mock return 503 for 3 attempts then 200.
expected_result: Job retries with backoff and jitter; UI shows degraded sync meanwhile; booking stays valid; eventual single event.

title: Cadence math fixture table
steps: 1) Run cadence for clients with 0, 1, 2, 4 intervals and IQR 14 vs 15 days.
expected_result: 0 → artist default 6 weeks, low; 1 → interval ±7 d, low; 2 → [P25,P75], medium; 4 with IQR ≤14 → high, IQR 15 → medium; evidence and model_version stored.

title: Consent checked at send time
steps: 1) Schedule an autopilot reminder; 2) revoke rebooking_reminders before send time; 3) run send.
expected_result: Send skipped with consent_revoked; autopilot_decisions row; no provider call.

title: Caps and quiet hours in client timezone
steps: 1) Artist in New York, client in Los Angeles; planner runs at 7 AM PT; 2) exceed per-client 14-day, per-cycle 2 and daily 10 caps.
expected_result: Send held until 9 AM client local; cap violations held/skipped with reason codes and next allowed time.

title: Autopilot OFF means zero automatic sends
steps: 1) Leave autopilot OFF with due clients; 2) run planner for 7 simulated days; 3) approve one reminder manually.
expected_result: No automatic sends; the manual per-message approval path sends exactly one.

title: Editing an approved template pauses it
steps: 1) Approve a rebooking template; 2) edit it; 3) run planner.
expected_result: New version status paused/needs_approval; planner skips with template_paused; old version not used.

title: Rebooking attribution window and no double attribution
steps: 1) Reminder at day 0, booking at day 13; 2) another at day 15; 3) a booking that also fills a slot event.
expected_result: Day 13 → one rebooked decision with value; day 15 → none; seat filler wins when booking fills a slot event; never two attributions.

title: Win-back requires a tap and has no Mova offer text
steps: 1) Open Win back; 2) wait for planner runs; 3) send one with no offer; 4) check copy sources.
expected_result: Nothing sends without Send tap; message contains only template + optional artist-written text; opted-out clients locked.

title: Activity log row per decision with reason and consent
steps: 1) Produce sent, skipped, held, failed, rebooked decisions; 2) export CSV.
expected_result: One row each with reason_code and consent_id where applicable; CSV export matches; status shown as icon + text.

title: Opted-out client never in any candidate list
steps: 1) Opt out a due client; 2) run autopilot planner, slot-draft selection and winback-list.
expected_result: Client absent from candidates (or shown locked for win-back) in all three.

title: Unapproved AI draft never sends
steps: 1) Generate template_draft and slot_copy with AI; 2) leave unapproved; 3) run planner and dispatch.
expected_result: No outbound message; drafts status needs_approval.

title: Manual Google booking-link guidance works
steps: 1) Open Reviews & Google profile; 2) follow manual guidance; 3) save google_review_url.
expected_result: Guidance shown; link saved and used by "Also leave it on Google".

title: No fake "synced" state; honest not-eligible
steps: 1) Render with integration unavailable, not eligible and provider error.
expected_result: Each shows an honest status and manual path; never "Synced" without a provider confirmation.

title: No unauthorized changes to third-party listings
steps: 1) With google_business_api flag OFF run all jobs.
expected_result: Zero GBP write calls; with flag ON only permitted operations in the adapter allow-list.

title: Share QR decodes on real phones
steps: 1) Show screen 21 at 50% brightness; 2) scan from 30 cm with iOS Camera and Android Camera/Lens.
expected_result: Both decode first try to PUBLIC_BASE_URL/s/:handle.

title: Share QR encoding properties
steps: 1) Generate QR for a handle; 2) decode with a reference decoder; 3) inspect modules.
expected_result: Error correction ≥ M; quiet zone ≥ 4 modules; decoded URL exact.

title: Unpublished profile QR shows "publish your page first"
steps: 1) Open Show my QR for a draft artist.
expected_result: No QR rendered; message and Publish action shown.

title: No wallet buttons on the artist QR screen
steps: 1) Render screen 21.
expected_result: Only Share link and Share image; Web Share with file where supported, else download.

title: PWA installability and update lifecycle
steps: 1) Lighthouse PWA audit; 2) install; 3) deploy a new build; 4) reopen.
expected_result: Valid manifest, icons, service worker; standalone start /app/home; update prompt applies new version.

title: Authenticated responses never cached publicly
steps: 1) Inspect service-worker cache after browsing clients and money; 2) sign out.
expected_result: No client/financial API responses in caches; offline shell only; caches cleared on sign-out.

title: Offline confirm booking is blocked
steps: 1) Go offline on checkout; 2) tap Pay & book.
expected_result: Clear unavailable/retry message; no request queued for later; no false confirmation.

title: Push permission requested contextually with fallbacks
steps: 1) Fresh install; 2) reach first booking notice opportunity; 3) deny permission.
expected_result: No prompt on first load; asks in context; denial falls back to in-app + email.

title: STOP reply suppresses immediately
steps: 1) Inbound "STOP" to the artist's Mova number; 2) to a shared-pool number; 3) attempt sends.
expected_result: Suppression for that artist (and platform-wide on shared number per ADR-0005); one confirmation sent; later sends skipped.

title: HELP keyword reply
steps: 1) Inbound "HELP" and "AYUDA".
expected_result: Approved help text returned in matching locale; no suppression.

title: Provider delivery failure
steps: 1) Delivery receipt with failure code; 2) replay the receipt.
expected_result: messages.failed with error_code; activity "Not delivered" with fix action; retry policy honoured; no duplicate send.

title: Inbound messages route to the right conversation
steps: 1) Inbound texts from a known client, a new number and an existing thread.
expected_result: Resolved to (artist, channel, thread); new conversation created when none; never to another artist.

title: Unregistered sending identity cannot send live
steps: 1) Set registration_status pending; 2) attempt live send.
expected_result: Blocked; sandbox transport only; Settings shows status honestly.

title: Messaging cost metered per artist
steps: 1) Send sandbox messages for two artists.
expected_result: cost_micros recorded per message and aggregated per artist only.

title: Entitlement bypass via direct API denied
steps: 1) On a plan without autopilot/seat_filler/concierge, call autopilot-settings, slot-approve, concierge-settings directly.
expected_result: 403 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED server-side; UI gating is not the only check.

title: Subscription webhook idempotent
steps: 1) Replay subscription.updated events out of order.
expected_result: Single correct entitlement state; no duplicate records.

title: Downgrade keeps customer data
steps: 1) Downgrade from AI Growth to Free.
expected_result: Features gate off; clients, notes, history, templates intact.

title: Billing reconciliation report
steps: 1) Generate the report for a fixture month.
expected_result: Subscription charges reconcile with Stripe fixture totals.

title: Plan screen shows proposed, not final, pricing
steps: 1) Render screen 22 in EN/ES.
expected_result: "Proposed pricing · not final" and [INCLUDED FEATURES · TO BE FINALIZED]; prices from config, not hardcoded.

title: New entitlement keys gate server-side
steps: 1) Evaluate each key (autopilot, seat_filler, seat_filler_autopilot, concierge, concierge_instagram, reports_advanced, reviews_public, wallet_client_card, message_credits_monthly) ON/OFF.
expected_result: Each key gates exactly its functions; matrix values come from config (A-01).

title: Core flows at 320/360 px in EN and ES
steps: 1) Run onboarding, showcase, request and instant booking, checkout, refund notice and notifications at 320/360 px in both locales.
expected_result: No overflow or truncation of critical copy; snapshots approved.

title: Switching language keeps selections and status
steps: 1) Select a service, day and time; 2) switch to ES; 3) continue.
expected_result: Selected service, day and time remain selected; UI switches to Spanish; guest locale persists and unrelated query parameters remain.

title: Guest locale independent of artist locale
steps: 1) Artist in EN; guest books in ES; 2) open artist dashboard.
expected_result: Dashboard stays EN; guest messages in ES; client_locale stored.

title: html lang and screen-reader language
steps: 1) Load pages in each locale; 2) inspect lang on root and on artist-authored text in other language.
expected_result: Correct lang attributes; original-language artist text labelled.

title: Locale key parity and critical-string check fails CI
steps: 1) Remove an es-US key marked critical; 2) run scripts/check-locales.mjs.
expected_result: Script exits non-zero naming the key; parity enforced across all namespaces incl. v2 additions.

title: Critical Spanish copy human-reviewed
steps: 1) Reviewer checks the five string sets listed in docs/engineering/manual/spanish-review.md against the current source revision; 2) record named review, date, disposition and exact approved key/template sets.
expected_result: Every critical string set has a human sign-off for the reviewed revision; changed or unsigned Spanish strings continue to block release.

title: No silent English fallback for policy/payment/consent
steps: 1) Delete an es-US critical key at runtime; 2) render the screen.
expected_result: Render blocked/error in test builds; never shows English for critical copy.

title: Missing ES template for ES client is skipped
steps: 1) ES client due; only EN template approved; fallback setting OFF; 2) run planner.
expected_result: Skip with no_template_for_locale; no English send; with explicit fallback setting ON English is allowed.

title: Intl formatting with location timezone
steps: 1) Format $1,234.50, dates and times for en-US/es-US across two timezones.
expected_result: Output matches Intl reference; appointment times in the location timezone.

title: Wallet pass fields localized and stable on update
steps: 1) Issue an ES pass; 2) reschedule.
expected_result: Pass fields in ES at issue; update keeps ES.

title: Booth rent vs commission calculator sample
steps: 1) Inputs: $1,500 weekly revenue, 40% commission, $300 rent, $150 shared expense.
expected_result: Commission take-home $750, booth $1,050, difference $300; labelled estimate, not tax/legal advice.

title: Calculator rejects invalid inputs
steps: 1) Enter negative revenue and 120% commission.
expected_result: Inline validation in EN/ES; no result shown.

title: Calculator values never leave the browser
steps: 1) Capture network while using the calculator.
expected_result: No entered financial values in any request, analytics or third-party call.

title: Waitlist submission paths
steps: 1) Submit valid, invalid, duplicate, bot-like, rate-limited and no-consent entries with UTM.
expected_result: Correct honest states; success only after persistence; locale, source and consent recorded; duplicates deduped; abuse blocked.

title: Marketing SEO in both locales
steps: 1) Crawl /en/* and /es/* with JS off; 2) validate sitemap and robots.
expected_result: Canonical, hreflang pairs, OG metadata, valid sitemap/robots; content present without JS.

title: No fake domain, testimonials or AI-placement claims
steps: 1) Review marketing copy and config.
expected_result: PUBLIC_BASE_URL configurable; no invented testimonials; no guaranteed AI-assistant placement.

title: Acquisition event taxonomy fires once
steps: 1) Walk landing → calculator → waitlist.
expected_result: landing_view, calculator_view, calculator_completed, waitlist_submit, waitlist_success fire once each with no PII.

title: Guest checkout identical with profile features OFF
steps: 1) Flag client_profiles OFF; 2) run full guest booking; 3) compare with baseline.
expected_result: No sign-in or save-profile UI; flow and outcome identical to guest baseline.

title: OTP expiry, attempts, rate limit, no enumeration
steps: 1) Request codes for known and unknown contacts; 2) submit 6 wrong codes; 3) use a code after 10 min; 4) flood from one IP.
expected_result: Identical responses for known/unknown; lock after 5 attempts; expired code rejected; rate limits per contact and IP; codes stored hashed only.

title: Booking links require verified exact match
steps: 1) Verify phone; 2) seed bookings with exact, near (one digit off) and other-artist matches; 3) claim.
expected_result: Only exact verified matches offered; each link confirmed individually; no silent merge across artists.

title: Stylist A cannot see client's relationship with B
steps: 1) Client linked to A and B; 2) with A's JWT query appointments, reviews, consents, links using B's IDs and the customer_account_id (DB + API fuzz).
expected_result: All denied/empty; no existence leak.

title: Signed-in client books two stylists
steps: 1) Sign in; book with A and with B; 2) view /me; 3) view each artist's client record.
expected_result: Client sees both under My stylists; A and B each see only their own relationship and appointments.

title: Profile deletion unlinks and deletes customer data
steps: 1) Delete profile with re-verification; 2) inspect customer tables, links, tokens and artist records.
expected_result: Customer-owned data deleted; links unlinked; card/session tokens revoked; artist client rows persist per retention and can no longer link.

title: Per-stylist consent toggles scoped to that tenant
steps: 1) Turn off reminders for A in /me.
expected_result: Only A's client_consents row changes, with evidence; B unchanged.

title: Wallet buttons hidden when flag OFF; image fallback always works
steps: 1) Flag wallet_client_card OFF; open 28, 29, 30; 2) Save the card as an image.
